paragraphs: Faloni Law Group, LLC is a full service Law Firm which was founded over 40 years ago by David A. Faloni, Sr., Esq. The firm is a regional law firm with offices in New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania.

Our experienced estate planning and elder law attorneys offer caring representation while building a strategy to help you achieve your goals by creating estate plans which limit or reduce taxes, offer simple efficient distribution, and protect assets while alive and upon death.
